history.period: 20th century onward (Welsh mission origins 1894; D.E. Jones arrived Aizawl 31 August 1897)
history.summary: AMBIGUITY FLAG: The CSV row name 'Presbyterian Church, Lunglei' is generic. No single Lunglei church carries that exact name, so this record documents the Presbyterian Church presence in Lunglei generally instead of a specific building. Presbyterian churches in Lunglei are local congregations of the Mizoram Presbyterian Church Synod (Mizoram Presbyterian Kohhran Synod), the largest Christian denomination in Mizoram with 6,28,719 members and 1,140 churches as of 2023, founded by Welsh Calvinistic Methodist missionaries and now a constituent body of the Presbyterian Church of India (HQ Shillong), with the Synod office at Mission Veng, Aizawl (verify). Note: southern Mizoram was historically the Baptist mission field - after the 1901 division of the Lushai Hills, the Welsh Presbyterian mission took the north and the Baptist Missionary Society took the south, and the first Mizo church was the Baptist church at Sethlun near Lunglei. Presbyterian congregations nevertheless exist across Lunglei today, e.g. Lunglei Chanmari Presbyterian Church, Ramthar Vengthar Presbyterian Church, Rahsi Veng Presbyterian Church and Pukpui Presbyterian Church (verify - all from local business listings, not church records). Do not conflate any of these with the Baptist churches (BCM) that dominate Lunglei's church landscape.

name: Presbyterian Church
town_description: Lunglei is the second-largest town in Mizoram and the headquarters of Lunglei district in southern Mizoram, set on forested ridges at roughly 1,100-1,200 m altitude (the name means 'bridge of rock'). Historically it was the Baptist mission field: the first independent Mizo church building stood at Sethlun near Lunglei (1902), and the Baptist Church of Mizoram has its headquarters at Serkawn, Lunglei. Today the town has churches of many denominations in its localities (Chanmari, Ramthar, Rahsi Veng, Pukpui, Bazar Veng), including Presbyterian ones.

travel.road: Lunglei lies about 170-180 km south of Aizawl; connected by national highway with regular buses and shared taxis from Aizawl (verify).
